TestRandomPaxos::test_topology_add_decom.description: Random but repeatable sequence of 5 actions (decommission+remove, add node w/ bootstrap, graceful reboot) on a 3..8 node cluster (NTS RF=3) while one LWT loader per node runs INSERT IF NOT EXISTS / UPDATE IF EXISTS at QUORUM. At the end all keys are read back (QUORUM/SERIAL) and compared against loader-tracked expected values; mismatches/missing/extra rows fail. Guards Paxos correctness under concurrent topology changes (no specific issue).
